description: This file defines the 'Number' utility class in the Drupal project, providing static methods for number validation, sorting code generation, and decoding.

classes.name: Number
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for number validation, sorting code generation, and decoding within Drupal.

methods.name: validStep
methods.description: Verifies if a number is a multiple of a given step, considering floating point precision and tolerances.

methods.name: intToAlphadecimal
methods.description: Converts an integer to a base-36 alpha-decimal sorting code with a length indicator.

methods.name: alphadecimalToInt
methods.description: Decodes a sorting code back into its integer value, handling deprecated cases and validation.
